# norm the TFs
tf.x1.current <- tf.x1.current/rowSums(tf.x1.current, na.rm=T)
tf.x2.current <- tf.x2.current/rowSums(tf.x2.current, na.rm=T)
if(taxa_change){
    tf.x1.current_change <- tf.x1.current_change/rowSums(tf.x1.current_change, na.rm=T)
    tf.x2.current_change <- tf.x2.current_change/rowSums(tf.x2.current_change, na.rm=T)
}

# reduce variance of tranfer functions
tann_tf_samples <- sample(x1range.bck,10000,prob=apply(tf.x1.current,2,mean,na.rm=T),replace=T)
pann_tf_samples <- sample(x2range.bck,10000,prob=apply(tf.x2.current,2,mean,na.rm=T),replace=T)

tann_tf_range <- c(0,25) #c( (mean(tann_tf_samples)-sd(tann_tf_samples)), (mean(tann_tf_samples)+sd(tann_tf_samples)) )
pann_tf_range <- c(0,1600) #c( (mean(pann_tf_samples)-sd(pann_tf_samples)), (mean(pann_tf_samples)+sd(pann_tf_samples)) )

if(max(age) >= 11000){
    tann_tf_range <- quantile(tann_tf_samples,c(0,0.95))
    pann_tf_range <- c(0,quantile(pann_tf_samples,0.95))
}else{
    tann_tf_range <- quantile(tann_tf_samples,c(0.05,0.95))
    pann_tf_range <- c(0,quantile(pann_tf_samples,0.95))
}

# no cutting of transfer functions

tann_tf_range <- range(x1range.bck)
pann_tf_range <- range(x2range.bck)

# print(tann_tf_range)
# print(pann_tf_range)

tf.x1.current[,!inside.range(x1range.bck,tann_tf_range)] <- 0
tf.x2.current[,!inside.range(x2range.bck,pann_tf_range)] <- 0
if(taxa_change){
    tf.x1.current_change[,!inside.range(x1range.bck,tann_tf_range)] <- 0
    tf.x2.current_change[,!inside.range(x2range.bck,pann_tf_range)] <- 0
}

# weight them for faster sample calculations
tf.x1.current.mean <- (tf.x1.current %*% x1range.bck)[,1] # expectation value
tf.x2.current.mean <- (tf.x2.current %*% x2range.bck)[,1] # expectation value

dims2 <- 100000
tann_expand <- spline(x1range.bck,n=dims2)$y
tf.x1.current.mean <- tf.x1.current.mean_change <- c()
for(j in 1:nrow(tf.x1.current) ){
    # weighted median of temperature in climate space
    tf.x1.current.mean[j] <- weightedMedian(x1range.bck,tf.x1.current[j,] )
    if(taxa_change) tf.x1.current.mean_change[j] <- weightedMedian(x1range.bck,tf.x1.current_change[j,] )
#     print(tf.x1.current.mean[j])
    # weighted mean of temperature in standard normal space
    
#     clim_expand  <- spline(tf.x1.current[j,],n=dims2)
#     tf.x1.current.mean[j] <- tann_expand[round(weightedMean(1:length(clim_expand$y),clim_expand$y ) )]
#     print(x1range.bck[round(weightedMean(1:dims,tf.x1.current[j,] ) )])
#     print(tf.x1.current.mean[j])
}


# image.plot(1:nrow(tf.x2.current),x2range.bck,tf.x2.current)



pann_expand <- spline(x2range.bck,n=dims2)$y
tf.x2.current.mean <- tf.x2.current.mean_change <- c()
for(j in 1:nrow(tf.x2.current) ){
    # weighted median of precip in standard climate space
    tf.x2.current.mean[j] <- weightedMedian(x2range.bck,tf.x2.current[j,] ) 
    if(taxa_change) tf.x2.current.mean_change[j] <- weightedMedian(x2range.bck,tf.x2.current_change[j,] )

#  which transfer functions are available
which.tf.missing <- which(is.na(tf.x1.current.mean))
if(length(which.tf.missing) != 0){
    taxa.appear.core <- taxa.appear.core[,-which.tf.missing]
    tf.x1.current <- tf.x1.current[-which.tf.missing,]
    tf.x2.current <- tf.x2.current[-which.tf.missing,]
    tf.x1.current.mean <- tf.x1.current.mean[-which.tf.missing]
    tf.x2.current.mean <- tf.x2.current.mean[-which.tf.missing]
    if(taxa_change){
        tf.x1.current.mean_change <- tf.x1.current.mean_change[-which.tf.missing]
        tf.x2.current.mean_change <- tf.x2.current.mean_change[-which.tf.missing]
    }
    
    all.avail <- all.avail[,-which.tf.missing]
    all.avail.age <- all.avail.age[,-which.tf.missing]
    num_taxa <- nrow(tf.x1.current)
}

which_taxa <- c(1:num_taxa)
prior$taxa.weights <- rep(1/num_taxa,times = num_taxa)
prior$phi <- num_taxa/2
prior$nr.taxa.mean <- posterior$nr.taxa.mean[1] <- num_taxa
prior$nr.taxa.sd <- round(num_taxa/4)

tf_x12_mean_current[,1] <- tf.x1.current.mean
tf_x12_mean_current[,2] <- tf.x2.current.mean

if(taxa_change){
    tf_x12_mean_current_change <- array(NA, dim = c(length(tf.x2.current.mean_change),2))
    tf_x12_mean_current_change[,1] <- tf.x1.current.mean_change
    tf_x12_mean_current_change[,2] <- tf.x2.current.mean_change
